_comment: workflow-release-video phases. Reuses the workflow-video-tour engine (scripts) unchanged; R1 and the R2 conventions are what this skill adds.
entrypoint: direct invocation, or the chief of staff's release flow

phases.name: Collect
phases.gate: confidence == high, range non-empty, fromTag is the expected tag

phases.name: Storyboard
phases.gate: beat 1 is kind:motivation in the reporter's/user's words from the release's own tickets (quote + reportedSymptom + affected + impact + narration; capture-beats.mjs refuses otherwise), then 7-9 chapters, 18-24 words/beat and 460-560 words total, planned total in 230-260 s, architecture beat before the first filmed beat, ERD for every chapter that touches the schema, every diagram rendered and looked at

phases.name: Capture
phases.gate: diagram contract passes (capture exits 2 otherwise), rect non-null on every filmed beat, still beats present with segment:null (cards and images), frame size == viewport
phases.checkpoints: every 4-5 chapters; fix with --only, never a full re-run

phases.name: Narration
phases.gate: voice-identity.py >= 0.99 one speaker, measuredS inside the hard band

phases.name: Assemble
phases.gate: all beats in the printed table (cards, diagram stills, filmed beats), durationS within 10 s of measuredS, contact sheet looked at (boxes on the right element, diagrams readable at 1600x900)

phases.name: Avatar + music
phases.gate: mascot on the cards and absent on the filmed beats; music licensed, long enough, and long-attributed

phases.name: Verify + publish
phases.gate: verify OK, one silence, chapters use real headings, asset downloads 200/302

beat_order: motivation (the problem this release answers, in the reporter's/user's words)
per chapter: divider, ERD (if the chapter touches the schema), filmed beats

motivation_contract.required: beat 1 is kind:motivation, stating the problem this release answers in the words of the people who reported it (from the release manifest's issues/tickets, not a paraphrase into engineering language); it carries quote / reportedSymptom / affected / impact / narration
motivation_contract.rendered_by: workflow-video-tour/scripts/compose-video.mjs (WHY THIS EXISTS card + verbatim quote + attribution)

diagram_contract.required: one architecture beat before the first filmed beat; one ERD per chapter that touches the data model, right after its divider; touchesDataModel: true on the storyboard
